description: Hyperliquid liquidations, by `view`. `fills`: liquidation events, newest first, filtered by symbol, wallet, side and time. Since 2026-08-03 rows are EXACT, the liquidated wallet's own fill from the node (`liq_ts` the fill's millisecond, sizes what it closed, `mark_price` the venue's mark); older rows are INFERRED from ~5-minute position snapshots (a position over $100 whose mark was within 5% of its liquidation price and which is gone from the next snapshot; `liq_ts` is that snapshot's time and size/mark are the last values seen; a hand close that near liquidation counts, partial liquidations are missed); `direction` is the side of the position that was CLOSED (long = longs liquidated, price fell) and each row's `pnl_cohort` carries a `pnl_cohort_basis` saying how it was labelled. `risk`: per symbol, the share of open notional close to liquidation: `percent_risk` is a FRACTION from 0 to 1 despite its name, ranked by that fraction, so thin micro-cap markets can top it (read `total_value_usd`, or pass `min_value_usd`). `heatmap`: one symbol, where its open positions' own liquidation prices cluster, in equal-width price bins weighted by notional USD; positions outside +-50% of mark or without a liquidation price are left out and counted under `coverage`. Same data as GET /v1/hyperliquid/{liquidations, liquidations/risk, symbols/{symbol}/liquidation-heatmap}.

axis.description: Cohort ladder: `size` = account-value tiers in USD, `pnl` = percentile rank of cumulative realized PnL (NOT dollars), `pnl_abs` = dollar bands of that same PnL. Used by view: risk.

bins.description: Number of equal-width price bins, minimum 5. The window is fixed at +-50% around the mark price. Max 500. Used by view: heatmap.

cohort.description: One label on `axis`, spelled exactly as `hl_segments` view=cohorts lists it, e.g. `whale` (size) or `3x smart` (pnl). Omit for all wallets. Used by view: risk.

cursor.description: `nextCursor` from the previous page, passed back verbatim; it is null on the last page. Omit it for the first page. Used by view: fills.

direction.description: The side of the position that was CLOSED: `long` = longs liquidated (price fell), `short` = shorts liquidated. Used by view: fills.

end.description: ISO-8601 UTC upper bound, e.g. 2026-10-02T00:00:00Z. Used by view: fills.

limit.description: Rows per page, newest first. Max by view: fills 5000, risk 500. Used by view: fills, risk.

min_value_usd.description: `risk` only: smallest total open notional in USD a symbol needs to be ranked. Default 0 (no floor), so thin micro-cap markets can lead; raise it to keep only markets big enough for a cascade to matter. Used by view: risk.

start.description: ISO-8601 UTC lower bound, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z. Used by view: fills.

symbol.description: Hyperliquid instrument ticker, e.g. BTC, ETH, HYPE; a HIP-3 market is `dex:TICKER`, e.g. xyz:TSLA. Used by view: fills, heatmap. Required by view: heatmap.

view.description: What to read. `fills`: liquidation events, newest first: exact from the node's fills since 2026-08-03, inferred from position snapshots before. `risk`: per symbol, the share of open notional close to liquidation. `heatmap`: where one symbol's open positions would liquidate, binned by price. Default `fills`.

wallet.description: One wallet, to ask whether it has been liquidated. Used by view: fills.
